title: AI engineer intern
description: Partial fit: honest about the gaps, strict about the evidence.
posting_text:
AI Engineer Intern - Lumen AI
You'll prototype LLM-powered features with our applied AI team.
Must have:
- Python
- Experience calling LLM APIs
- Understanding of AI agents and tool calling
Nice to have:
- RAG / vector databases

profile.name: Alex Example
profile.summary: Computer engineering student focused on backend and AI applications, with internship experience in QA and consulting.

bullets.text: Designed and executed functional test cases for a banking web application in an Agile team.
Tracked and triaged defects in Jira and validated data with SQL queries.
Built a FastAPI backend that scans the local network and serves device status to an HTML dashboard.
Runs as a background service with automatic restart.
Python scraper that finds flights under a price threshold and emails an HTML summary.
Scheduled weekly with GitHub Actions.

matches.note: Demonstrated Python proficiency across multiple backend and automation projects.
Completed an AI Agents course covering LLMs, but does not detail project experience calling LLM APIs directly.
Completed Hugging Face AI Agents course.
Hugging Face AI Agents course covered tool calling concepts.
No mention of RAG concepts or implementations in profile.

fit.summary: Candidate possesses solid Python fundamentals and theoretical understanding of AI agents and tool calling from coursework, but lacks practical LLM API integration projects as well as RAG and vector database familiarity.

summary.text: Computer engineering student with hands-on experience developing Python backends and automations, complemented by coursework in AI agents and tool calling.

bullets.text: Built a FastAPI backend that scans the local network and serves device status to an HTML dashboard.
Configured the application to run as a persistent background service with automatic restart.
Created a Python scraper that monitors flight prices below a set threshold and sends HTML email notifications.
Automated weekly execution using GitHub Actions workflows.
Designed and executed functional test cases for a banking web application within an Agile team.
Tracked and triaged defects in Jira and performed data validation using SQL queries.

paragraphs.text: Lumen AI's focus on prototyping LLM-powered features matches my engineering focus on backend development and applied AI. In Python, I have built a FastAPI backend to monitor local network devices and created an automated flight price scraper scheduled with GitHub Actions.

I completed Hugging Face's AI Agents Course, which provided a structured understanding of LLMs, agent architectures, and tool calling mechanisms. This foundation prepares me to assist your team with evaluating and structuring agent interactions.

While my experience with LLMs and tool calling is grounded in coursework rather than commercial API integration, my computer engineering studies and core Python skills provide the technical base needed to adapt quickly to your applied AI workflows.
